text:
[9:33 p.m. MST]

Work on issue FV-568VXF: Colour temperature slider

In the popup, add a slider for colour temperature (about 1900 K to 6500 K, default 3500 K) with a label showing the Kelvin value and a short warm/cool hint. Changing it updates the screen live while night light is on, and is saved and restored at startup. Convert Kelvin to gamma ramps in the gamma backend, with unit tests. Still set through the Wayland gamma protocol only (R2).

Labels: Applet

output:
- [k1] The gamma backend runs on a dedicated worker thread (Worker in src/main.rs); the UI talks to it with Task::perform and a oneshot. State is saved with cosmic::cosmic_config::Config get/set, key 'enabled', version 1. Futures come from cosmic::iced::futures. Not tested live: if cosmic-comp lacks zwlr_gamma_control, the icon stays off and the error goes to stderr. The user wants gamma set direc…
- [k2] libcosmic is pinned by rev in Cargo.toml and the justfile builds with --locked; bump the rev on purpose. Not verified live: cosmic-comp advertising zwlr_gamma_control, and the desktop file's Categories on a COSMIC session.
- [k6] Right-click popup: cosmic::widget::mouse_area around applet.icon_button, then a Task from cosmic::task::message(cosmic::Action::Surface(app_popup::<App>(..))); on_close_requested must return a PopupClosed message. The popup id logic is the pure helper popup_after_close. Not tested on a live panel.

input.request: Add a colour-temperature slider (1900-6500 K, default 3500) to the popup with Kelvin label and warm/cool hint; live update while on; persist and restore. Kelvin->ramp already exists in gamma.rs; add range constants/clamp and tests.
input.plan: Add MIN/MAX constants + clamp in gamma.rs with tests; worker request carries kelvin; Settings gains temperature; Message::Temperature updates, saves, re-applies when enabled (coalescing while busy); popup view shows slider.
